questions.q1: What makes Slovenščina Korak za Korkom different from other language learning programs?
questions.q2: Do I need any prior knowledge of Slovene (or other languages) to start?
questions.q4: Can I try a lesson before committing to a full course?

answers.a1: Slovenščina Korak za Korkom offers a personalized learning experience tailored to your needs. We focus on practical communication skills rather than just memorizing vocabulary. Our lessons are interactive and flexible, with experienced tutors who guide you step by step. Whether you’re a beginner or improving your fluency, we ensure a structured and engaging learning journey.
answers.a2: Not at all! Our program is designed for all levels, from complete beginners to advanced learners. If you already have some knowledge, we will assess your level and customize the lessons to help you progress efficiently.
answers.a3: Our lessons are conducted via live video sessions with experienced tutors. You’ll have interactive exercises, real-time feedback, and customized materials. You can choose your schedule and learn at your own pace, making it easy to fit language learning into your daily routine.
answers.a4: Yes! We offer a trial lesson so you can experience our teaching approach firsthand. This helps you understand how our program works and allows us to assess your level and learning goals. Sign up today and start your language journey with confidence!

hero.title: About us
hero.subtitle: Slovenščina Korak za Korakom is a Slovenian language learning platform built for anyone who needs to learn Slovenian that actually works in real life, not just on paper.
hero.text1: Whether you’ve just moved to Slovenia, are preparing for an exam, or simply want to connect more deeply with the country and its people, we’re here to guide you through every step.

mission.title: Where We Come From
mission.subtitle: Our story
mission.text1: Our story starts not in a classroom, but in a small town called Mozirje, population 5,000, where two kids arrived from Ukraine with no Slovenian and no roadmap.
mission.text2: That was Oleksandr and Sofia (our founders) who moved to Slovenia with their family 12 years ago. With no Russian-speaking community to lean on, they had no choice but to dive in: school, sports clubs, music lessons, friendships — all in Slovenian, from day one. They didn’t just adapt. They thrived. Both went on to pass their NPZ exams and Matura with strong results at the I Gimnazija Celje. Sofia pursued law and Oleksandr completed his economics degree and is currently finishing his master’s.
mission.text3: That journey gave them something most language programs are built without, a genuine understanding of what it feels like to start from zero, and what it actually takes to get fluent.

built.title: What We Built
built.subtitle: From informal lessons to a full platform
built.text1: What started as informal lessons for friends who had just arrived in Slovenia gradually grew into something much bigger.
built.text2: Over three years, Oleksandr and Sofia structured their experience into a proper teaching methodology, testing approaches, building materials, and refining what works. As demand grew, they expanded into a full platform with a carefully selected team of native Slovenian teachers, a rich digital learning library, a speaking club, and free educational content across Instagram and Telegram.
built.text3: Today, Slovenščina Korak za Korakom serves students at every level. From complete beginners to those preparing for state and specialized exams with a program that is structured, proven, and built around real progress.

team.title: Our Team
team.subtitle: Native teachers, trained in our methodology
team.text1: Every teacher on our platform is a native Slovenian speaker, with hands-on teaching experience. Each one was personally trained in our methodology and tested with real students before joining the team.

different.title: What Makes Us Different
different.subtitle: Slovenian as a lived experience
different.text1: Most language programs teach Slovenian as a subject. We teach it as a lived experience.
different.text2: Because our founders went through integration themselves, our approach goes beyond grammar rules and textbook exercises. We focus on how the language is actually used. The rhythm of conversation, the expressions that don’t appear in any textbook, the confidence that comes from truly understanding what’s being said around you.
different.text3: That perspective shapes everything: how we structure lessons, how we select teachers, how we support students outside the classroom, and how we keep improving.

contact.title: What’s Next
contact.subtitle: We’re just getting started
contact.text1: We’re not standing still. Video courses and an AI-powered Slovenian learning tool are currently in development and coming to the platform soon. We’re building the most complete and accessible Slovenian learning experience available — and we’re just getting started.
contact.text2: Want to see how we work? Register and try your first lesson for free.
